title: Zon, Zee … Zorgeloos: accessible beaches on the Belgian coast
description: Inter's page on Zon, Zee … Zorgeloos, the summer service that makes beaches on the Belgian coast accessible. Per coastal town (De Panne, Nieuwpoort, Oostende, Bredene, De Haan and Wenduine, Zeebrugge and others): what is available (reserved parking, accessible tram stop, accessible toilet and changing room with hoist, paved beach access, free beach wheelchairs, electric beach wheelchairs), how to book a beach wheelchair (phone, website), where to find it, assistants who help with moving, dressing and the toilet, and the dates of the season (mostly July and August). Seasonal information that changes each year; texts in Dutch.
licence_note: Published on vlaanderen.be, whose disclaimer allows free reuse (https://www.vlaanderen.be/over-vlaanderenbe/disclaimer).

assessment.note: Web page of Inter, the Flemish expertise centre for accessibility, on the beach service run by the coastal towns; seasonal, check the page date.
